text: Find the image of the point \((-4, 7)\) under the linear transformation represented by \(\begin{pmatrix} 3 & -1 \\ 1 & 3 \end{pmatrix}\).
Write down the matrix that represents a rotation of 180° about the origin.
explanation:
Under a rotation of 180° about the origin, the image of \((1, 0)\) forms the first column and the image of \((0, 1)\) forms the second column.

This gives \(\begin{pmatrix} -1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix}\).

Multiply rows of \(A\) by columns of \(B\).

Top-left: \((-1)(3) + (-1)(-2) = -1\)

Top-right: \((-1)(-2) + (-1)(-2) = 4\)

Bottom-left: \((-2)(3) + (1)(-2) = -8\)

Bottom-right: \((-2)(-2) + (1)(-2) = 2\)

So \(AB = \begin{pmatrix} -1 & 4 \\ -8 & 2 \end{pmatrix}\).
